GuestbookEntry.title: GuestbookEntry
GuestbookEntry.description: A congratulatory wedding guestbook message written by a wedding guest.

authorName.description: Display name of the guest leaving a congratulatory message.

side.description: Whether the guest is from the groom side, bride side, or a mutual friend.

isPublic.description: Whether the guestbook message is visible on the wedding invitation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the guestbook message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the guestbook message was last updated.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Marker document identifying a wedding host administrator.

/guestbookEntries/{entryId}.description: Publicly readable and guest-creatable wedding guestbook entries with admin moderation.
